Update the version fields of the component tables from filing evidence

Source: R/xpath-versions.R
update_xpath_versions.Rd

Recomputes schema_versions, earliest_version, latest_version, current_version and pct_filers_reporting in xpaths.csv with xpath_version_fields(). Run it after refreshing the evidence from the ef2 builds (data-raw/update-xpath-versions.R writes the result). These are derived_columns, so the change log does not record their values.

Usage

update_xpath_versions(
  src = read_src(),
  obs = xpath_observations(),
  scope = c("xpath", "variable")
)

Arguments

src

Component tables (default: read_src()). xpaths must already have the 2.0 columns (schema_versions, earliest_version, pct_filers_reporting; added by fix 24).

obs

Output of xpath_observations().

scope

"xpath" or "variable"; see Description.

Value

src with the updated xpaths table.
